void.$description: Void — Page canvas, hero backgrounds, deepest surface layer

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Card surfaces, elevated panels, code block backgrounds

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary card surfaces, hover states, nested panels

iron.$description: Iron — Borders, dividers, subtle separators, table lines

steel.$description: Steel — Stronger borders, input outlines, card edges

slate.$description: Slate — Icon strokes, secondary borders, button outlines

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted text, inactive labels, tertiary content

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary text, descriptions, helper text

bone.$description: Bone — Light secondary text, subtle emphasis

pearl.$description: Pearl — Near-white text, icon fills, high-contrast labels

paper.$description: Paper — Primary text, logo marks, maximum contrast headings

bun-pink.$description: Bun Pink — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

magenta-core.$description: Magenta Core — Hover states on pink CTAs, gradient endpoint for headlines, emphasis text

rose-petal.$description: Rose Petal — Light pink backgrounds for tags, soft highlights, gradient midpoint

blush.$description: Blush — Softest pink for background washes, subtle pink tints

wine.$description: Wine — Pink-tinted borders for highlighted sections, badge outlines

plum.$description: Plum — Deep pink-tinted backgrounds for active states or featured panels

violet.$description: Violet — Decorative accent, gradient endpoint, illustration highlights

lavender.$description: Lavender — Headline gradient, icon accents, link hover states

lilac.$description: Lilac — Soft violet text, gradient midpoint, subtle highlights

cyan.$description: Cyan — Code syntax highlighting, tool accent for Postgres/data features

amber.$description: Amber — Code syntax highlighting, tool accent for runtime features, warm contrast

gold.$description: Gold — Code syntax highlighting, test runner badge accent, attention markers

mint.$description: Mint — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

system-ui.$description: Primary typeface for all prose, headings, navigation, buttons, and UI text. The full weight range (300–800) gives the system flexibility from whisper-light display headings to bold section labels. Large display sizes (48–60px) carry headline weight, while 16–18px holds body copy at a comfortable reading rhythm.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Monospace companion for all executable content: code blocks, terminal commands, file paths, version strings, package names. Tight line-height (1.11) at smaller sizes keeps code dense and scannable. The 500/600 weights are used for emphasis inside code, not body text.
